lineage_breadth_rules.MULTI_LINEAGE: not BROAD and genome_n>=3 AND unique_taxonomy_tail3_n>=2

review_strata_rules.E3B1_BROAD_COHERENT_REPLICATED: BROAD_MULTI_LINEAGE AND official_witness_support_fraction>=0.75 AND modal_side_fraction>=0.75 AND no known-system keyword candidate
review_strata_rules.E3B2_MULTI_LINEAGE_COHERENT_REPLICATED: MULTI_LINEAGE AND official_witness_support_fraction>=0.75 AND modal_side_fraction>=0.75 AND no known-system keyword candidate
review_strata_rules.E3B3_MULTI_LINEAGE_HETEROGENEOUS_RETAINE: BROAD_MULTI_LINEAGE or MULTI_LINEAGE not assigned above
review_strata_rules.E3B4_NARROW_COHERENT_REPLICATED: NARROW AND official_witness_support_fraction>=0.50 AND modal_side_fraction>=0.75 AND no known-system keyword candidate
review_strata_rules.E3B5_SPECIAL_CONFLICT_REVIEW: otherwise; includes annotation conflict/missing official witness or known-system-context flags

claim_boundaries: Review strata are post-E3A review-order categories, not discovery filters and not novelty calls.
Taxonomy-tail diversity is a lineage dereplication proxy, not a phylogenetic distance estimate.
Official annotation absence is not novelty evidence.
A CRISPR/Cas keyword in a 10-kb neighborhood is context only and does not establish a retro system.
